findings.text: §15's Change states that "a fresh dispatch and a lane change write the run's prompt file from it" (`plan.stdin_text`), but `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2126` writes `prompt.txt` for every launch kind while the plan is composed only inside the `launch_kind == "cli"` branch at `:2079`/`:2423`, so on an `in-harness` launch — a launch kind `reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:451` accepts and `reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:177` reads — there is no composed plan and no `stdin_text` to write from
